## Summary

Describe the user-facing and architectural change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run architecture:validate`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] E2E/accessibility tests updated when a user flow changed

## Security and dependency review

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or plaintext sensitive data were added.
- [ ] Any dependency change has a clear reason, owner, and bundle/security impact.
